# Seed data (SIMULATED)

* `seed_demo.sql` — generated by `backend/tools/export_seed_sql` from `src/services/DemoSeeder.cpp`
  (the single source of truth). Apply after `schema/schema.sql`. Timestamps are fixed at generation time.
* Easier: leave `"auto_seed": true` in `config.json`; the server seeds an empty database on first start.
